title: The Small Promise
author: Tamsin Okafor
blurb: Freya Fairweather, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
